nodes.label: zram-first sysctl profile for an 8 GB KDE desktop
nodes.norm_label: zram-first sysctl profile for an 8 gb kde desktop
nodes.summary: The host runs 7.6 GiB RAM with swap supplied only by /dev/zram0 3.8G (zstd), no disk swap. The session installs /etc/sysctl.d/99-zram.conf with vm.swappiness=180, vm.watermark_boost_factor=0, vm.watermark_scale_factor=125 and vm.page-cluster=0, enables systemd-oomd against freezes, and leaves zram at ram/2 because that is already safe for this capacity.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L176] vm.swappiness=60 - kurang optimal untuk zram. The 3.8G zram device is judged sufficient at ram/2, so zram-size = ram is offered only as an option for heavy Firefox-plus-coding days.

nodes.label: A stdin redirect collides with a piped sudo password and trips pam_faillock
nodes.norm_label: a stdin redirect collides with a piped sudo password and trips pam_faillock
nodes.summary: The command shape `echo pass | sudo -S tee /path < /tmp/file` gives sudo two stdin sources at once; the redirect wins, so sudo reads the file contents as the password. Three wrong reads inside one command, plus more sudo failures in the same shell call, exceeded pam_faillock deny=3 and locked the account for the default 600 s. The lock is cleared only by waiting out unlock_time or by rebooting, because /run/faillock is tmpfs.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L753] Saya kirim 3 perintah `sudo` sekaligus dalam satu call. Total >3 gagal → kena `pam_faillock deny=3` → lock jam 23:02:52 seperti di log.

nodes.label: NOPASSWD in a sudoers drop-in as the fix for a TTY-less agent shell
nodes.norm_label: nopasswd in a sudoers drop-in as the fix for a tty-less agent shell
nodes.summary: The agent's shell has no TTY, so sudo can never read a password interactively and every privileged step stalls on the human. The resolution offered and taken was a /etc/sudoers.d/10-agentic drop-in granting NOPASSWD, after which `sudo -n true` returns exit 0 and the sysctl work applies unattended. The scoped variant (a whitelist of systemctl, sysctl, tee, cp, mv, chmod, udevadm) was recommended over NOPASSWD: ALL.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L751] Shell saya tidak punya TTY, jadi `sudo` selalu gagal baca password secara interaktif. Harus pakai `echo pass | sudo -S ...`.

nodes.label: libcups and avahi are reverse dependencies of firefox, gtk3 and plasma, so the printer stack cannot be pruned
nodes.norm_label: libcups and avahi are reverse dependencies of firefox, gtk3 and plasma, so the printer stack cannot be pruned
nodes.summary: On this host no cups daemon is installed at all and avahi-daemon is disabled and inactive, so the printer stack already costs zero RAM. pactree -r shows libcups pulled in by freerdp, gtk3 and libnma, and avahi pulled in through libcups, so removing either package breaks firefox, gtk3 and plasma. The only removable piece is print-manager (2.72 MiB), which plasma-meta requires, and it is disk-only savings anyway.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L1389] Tetap butuh library-nya untuk Firefox/GTK, jangan hapus paket `avahi` + `libcups` — hapus itu jebol `firefox, gtk3, plasma`.

nodes.label: A whisper/ggml SIGILL lands inside ggml_backend_cpu_reg_get_device on an AVX2-only CPU
nodes.norm_label: a whisper/ggml sigill lands inside ggml_backend_cpu_reg_get_device on an avx2-only cpu
nodes.summary: The released Snipset AppImage crashes with SIGILL during whisper init on an i3-10105 whose /proc/cpuinfo lists avx2 but no avx512. gdb on the coredump puts frame #0 at ggml_backend_cpu_reg_get_device reached through ggml_dev_count and whisper_init_with_params_no_state, and the faulting instruction is vinserti64x2 — an EVEX-only form. Clang confirms the mapping independently: compiling _mm256_inserti64x2 with -mavx2 alone is rejected with 'needs target feature avx512dq,avx512vl'.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L2799] vinserti64x2 $0x1,%xmm1,%ymm0,%ymm0 — the exact instruction the kernel logged as the trap address for the tokio-rt-worker thread.

nodes.label: whisper-rs-sys build.rs declares no rerun-if-env-changed for GGML_*, so changing it needs a CI cache key bump
nodes.norm_label: whisper-rs-sys build.rs declares no rerun-if-env-changed for ggml_*, so changing it needs a ci cache key bump
nodes.summary: whisper-rs-sys 0.15.0's build.rs forwards every GGML_* environment variable into the whisper.cpp cmake build as a -D define, but it declares rerun-if-env-changed only for other variables. So setting GGML_AVX512=OFF in a workflow leaves a warm target/ cache silently reusing the AVX512 objects. The fix paired the env change with prefix-key: ggml-noavx512-v1 in both the Linux and Windows desktop jobs, plus a one-off timeout bump from 60 to 90 minutes for the cold rebuild.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L6777] Wajib, karena `build.rs` tidak deklarasi `rerun-if-env-changed` untuk `GGML_*`, jadi cache `target/` lama diam-diam pakai binary AVX512 lama kalau key tidak diganti.

nodes.label: Scanning the extracted AppImage binary for the EVEX 0x62 opcode proves the AVX512 question without running it
nodes.norm_label: scanning the extracted appimage binary for the evex 0x62 opcode proves the avx512 question without running it
nodes.summary: In 64-bit mode only EVEX (AVX512) instructions begin with byte 0x62, so a byte scan of the extracted usr/bin/snipset answers whether a shipped binary contains AVX512 instructions at all, with no execution needed. This session turns that into a whole-binary post-build regression gate: extract the AppImage, objdump the binary, fail the job if any instruction encoding starts with 62. The gate is Linux-only because the Windows runner has no objdump. Note this is the whole-binary form; a separate session narrowed an equivalent guard to the ggml dispatch path because whole-binary scans false-positive on dormant AVX512 in upstream variant kernels.

nodes.label: A Civo dashboard SSH key is injected only when the instance is created
nodes.norm_label: a civo dashboard ssh key is injected only when the instance is created
nodes.summary: Registering an SSH key in the Civo dashboard does nothing to an instance that is already running. The key is written into authorized_keys at instance creation, so a VPS created before the key was registered neither receives it nor stops refusing port 22, and must be repaired through the out-of-band console or recreated with the new key.
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L07190] VPS `49.128.191.153` yang sudah jalan tidak otomatis dapat key ini, dan port 22-nya tetap refused — jadi setelah daftar, VPS itu tetap perlu diperbaiki via web console Civo (cek `sshd` + firewall), atau buat ulang instance dengan key ini.

nodes.label: Civo recovery mode plus a chroot into the root filesystem restores sshd on a VPS refusing every port
nodes.norm_label: civo recovery mode plus a chroot into the root filesystem restores sshd on a vps refusing every port
nodes.summary: When every port including 22 refuses while the Civo firewall shows all TCP, UDP and ICMP open on 0.0.0.0/0, the fault is inside the guest and no network change will help. The recovery path is: `civo instance recovery enable`, reboot, take the VNC console session, mount the root device, then `chroot /mnt systemctl enable sshd` and set a password so the console itself remains an entry point.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L9875] Firewall terbuka penuh — masalah murni `sshd` di dalam VM. Masuk recovery mode.

nodes.label: fail2ban ignoreip must cover a whole IPv6 /64, not a single host address
nodes.norm_label: fail2ban ignoreip must cover a whole ipv6 /64, not a single host address
nodes.summary: Three devices — the Arch desktop, a Chromebook and a Termux tablet — reach the VPS from one IPv4 address behind the same NAT plus several addresses inside one IPv6 /64. Whitelisting the individual IPv6 addresses one at a time works but is fragile, because privacy extensions rotate the host part. Writing the /64 into ignoreip once covers every device and survives host-address changes; Arch and the tablet share the IPv4 address, so one entry serves both.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - optimasi-ram-arch-sesuai-kapasitas [ses_f3100fe4cffephOMLUpOT1osmt].md:L11606] Arch, Chromebook, dan tablet tercakup, dan ganti-ganti host IPv6 dalam prefix yang sama tetap aman.

nodes.label: A plan status verdict needs verifiable evidence, not ticked checkboxes
nodes.norm_label: a plan status verdict needs verifiable evidence, not ticked checkboxes
nodes.summary: The task framing for this session states the rule directly: a plan is never called done because the plan says so, and mixed or absent evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE rather than a guess, because the verdict will change the plan's recorded status.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-more-snipset-plans [ses_f2093432dffe2F5Yux2vEub2pj].md:L56] Never call something done because the plan says so. That is the exact error this task exists to prevent.

nodes.label: A plan verdict comes from what the repository contains, not from the plan's prose
nodes.norm_label: a plan verdict comes from what the repository contains, not from the plan's prose
nodes.summary: All three plans carry status: Draft while two of them have committed production changes. Checking each acceptance criterion against files that exist and tests that run produces three different verdicts — PARTIAL, PARTIAL, FINISHED — from three documents whose frontmatter is identical. The status line in the plan is therefore not evidence of anything, in either direction.

nodes.label: A plan's named commit can be a one-line Markdown reformat that implements nothing
nodes.norm_label: a plan's named commit can be a one-line markdown reformat that implements nothing
nodes.summary: The commit cited for the Telegram monitoring plan, 5e5a4fcfa style(website): format monitoring plan ledger, is a one-line whitespace change to the plan file. It implements no acceptance criterion. The report treats it as a citation artifact rather than a gap, because the real implementation exists as a separate commit series whose subjects match the plan's per-task commit messages one for one.

nodes.label: A criterion's subject side must match the commit that supposedly implemented it
nodes.norm_label: a criterion's subject side must match the commit that supposedly implemented it
nodes.summary: The Linux WebKitGTK empty-voice plan is named for a desktop concern, and the brief asserted it was a Tauri/Rust matter. The plan itself says the opposite in two places: §3 states the change is frontend-only with no Rust compilation required, and §1 non-goals exclude any Rust code. The change lands entirely in apps/web, the React UI the Tauri/WebKitGTK shell renders, so a desktop symptom was fixed in the frontend.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-more-snipset-plans [ses_f2093432dffe2F5Yux2vEub2pj].md:L5260] **desktop-adjacent but frontend-only.** The plan's own §3 says "Frontend-only change. No Rust compilation is required" and §1 Non-Goals explicitly exclude "any Rust code".

nodes.label: A cited commit subject may not exist verbatim; report the one that does
nodes.norm_label: a cited commit subject may not exist verbatim; report the one that does
nodes.summary: The brief cited the commit as fix(speech): keep the voice profile selected. No commit carries that subject; the real one is fix(speech): keep the voice profile selector readable when no voices exist (c4fd92efd). Here the subject matter does match, so it is a wording discrepancy only — but the report records the actual subject rather than echoing the brief.

nodes.label: A select whose list can be empty must still render at least one option
nodes.norm_label: a select whose list can be empty must still render at least one option
nodes.summary: When getVoices() returns an empty array on Linux WebKitGTK, the Voice Profile select previously rendered as a blank, apparently-enabled greyed box that read as a defect. The fix adds a placeholder option as the first child whenever the profile list is empty and forces the value to the empty string, so the control can never appear blank. A test asserts options.length > 0 in that state.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-more-snipset-plans [ses_f2093432dffe2F5Yux2vEub2pj].md:L5281] `{availableProfiles.length === 0 && (<option value="">{t("ttsProfileUnavailableOption")}</option>)}` as first child, plus `value={availableProfiles.length === 0 ? "" : voiceProfileId}`. Test at `:127` asserts `options.length > 0`.

nodes.label: A purely visual CSS rule has no jsdom-assertable RED test
nodes.norm_label: a purely visual css rule has no jsdom-assertable red test
nodes.summary: The disabled-treatment rule for the settings select is two CSS declarations, so there is no failing assertion a jsdom run can produce before the edit. The plan records this as an accepted limitation of the reproduction strategy and carries objective coverage on the structural tests instead, with the accessibility and contrast suites run first to capture the green baseline the new rule must not regress.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-more-snipset-plans [ses_f2093432dffe2F5Yux2vEub2pj].md:L5290] There is no jsdom-assertable RED for a purely visual rule; this is recorded as an accepted limitation of the reproduction strategy.

nodes.norm_label: unavailability copy must name the cause and the concrete install remedy in both locales

The new EN and ID strings say no system speech voices were detected and name the fix verbatim — install speech-dispatcher and espeak-ng, then restart Snipset — with key parity maintained across the two locale files.
